scripts.build: fumadocs-mdx && bun run typecheck && next build && bun run scripts/export-markdown.ts && bun run scripts/verify-export.ts
scripts.check: bun run check:content && fumadocs-mdx && bun run typecheck
scripts.//typecheck: next.config.mjs sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors, so `next build` skips its own tsc pass; this tsrs pass runs before it instead and fails the build on any type error. `typecheck:tsc` is the TypeScript 5 fallback for platforms tsrs ships no binary for (Windows, Intel macOS).
scripts.check:content: bun run scripts/check-content.ts && bun run scripts/lint-markdown.ts
